eps.d: The beautiful Leah sees her arrival at the prophet's house as a chance to salvage her life and gain power over the elusive, charismatic Wroe.
Joanna joins Wroe's church with fervent hopes of carrying out missionary work among the mill workers. But Wroe has other plans for her.
Hannah's socialist beliefs have no place in Wroe's apocalyptic world view, but they nevertheless build up a strong intellectual and emotional bond.
For 15 years Martha has been treated as an animal - but she is a sensitive and silent witness to the secrets of the other virgins' lives.
